summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into Red Bull's first victory of the season, controlling the race from start to finish despite unprecedented software glitches that forced multiple cars into limp-home mode before the start. A critical pit-stop call in lap 34 shifted the race's momentum when Verstappen's team moved him ahead of the recovering Lewis Hamilton, prompting the Mercedes driver to later describe the chaotic day as turning F1 into a "Lego race." The win extends Verstappen's championship lead and signals Red Bull's technical upgrade package has restored them as the grid's dominant force heading into the season's second phase.
